legacy_and_modern_runtime_comparison: Descriptive separate cohorts only; no causal speed ratio across historical hardware/runtime.
cache_condition: New empty Inductor and Triton directories per process; optional remote caches disabled before Torch import. Not cold filesystem/driver/download caches.
statistical_unit: Six intact four-process AB/BA reversal groups; all twelve pairs and fixed scenes remain within their groups.
compile_only_time: Unmeasured unless separately directly instrumented. First request and cold-prefix premium include compilation and other initialization.
break_even: Cold prefix plus extrapolated warm requests; retain infinite crossings in uncertainty bounds.
admission: Fresh Phase 1 hardware, runtime, cost, storage, cleanup and immutable execution bounds required; canceled three-policy allocation is not reusable.
